Get CBA Rosters

Source: R/cba.R
cba_rosters.Rd

Registered rosters of both sides with player bio fields (the season registration, not the game box).

Endpoint: GET https://data-server.cbaleague.com/api/schedules/getPlayersByScheduleId/{schedule_id}

Usage

cba_rosters(schedule_id)

Arguments

schedule_id

(required) Required. CBA game id (integer), the global 9-digit sequence 100xxxxxx (100105799 = 2025-26 round 1). Only a finished game is served.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble: One row per registered player (season registration, not the game box). An empty valid answer is a zero-row tibble with these columns, in this order (sdv-py cba_rosters):

col_nametypedescription
schedule_idintegerCBA game id (key space: CBA games, ONE global 9-digit sequence 100xxxxxx across seasons and match types; the {scheduleId} of every game route). Stamped by the runtime from the request; null on a body parsed without it.
sidecharacterSide of the game the row belongs to: home (the API's host / home block) or away (guest / visiting block).
ageintegerAge in years as registered (0 on every sampled row: not maintained).
birth_datecharacterDate of birth 'YYYY-MM-DD'. A public player bio field of the roster (kept; officials' and coaches' dates would be redacted by the capture).
body_datacharacterJSON string of physical-testing results as the league stores it (wingspan, standing reach, vertical reach, hand size); null where not tested.
cn_aliascharacterPlayer short name (Chinese).
cn_alias_showcharacterDisplay name (Chinese); '—' for a placeholder row.
cn_namecharacterPlayer full name (Chinese; may include a first-name form for foreigners).
created_datecharacterAudit field: row creation time 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'.
first_namecharacterGiven name in Latin letters as registered, in capitals (e.g. 'CAI S.L.S.').
heightintegerHeight in cm (integer).
idcharacterInternal row id of the (player, team, season) registration, a 19-digit integer beyond 2^53: read it as a string/int64, never as a JS number. Not the playerId.
is_captainlogicalTeam captain flag (false on every sampled row).
is_deletelogicalSoft-delete flag (false on every sampled row).
is_injurylogicalInjury flag (false on every sampled row).
is_threeintegerFlag, 2 on every sampled row; meaning unverified.
last_modified_datecharacterAudit field: last modification time; null on rows never modified.
last_namecharacterFamily name in Latin letters; ” when none, and null on some older rows.
match_type_idintegerMatch type id (1 = regular season) of the registration.
nationalitycharacterNationality (Chinese country name; see the nationality code table for every value seen and its English name). Chinese country names seen: China; United States; Canada; France; Chinese Taipei; Iran; Nigeria; Jordan.
numbercharacterJersey number as a string.
player_cba_idintegerA registration id from the league's own system (e.g. 502672); 0 when unset (27 of 101 sampled rows). Not the playerId (unverified beyond that).
player_idintegerplayerId (key space: CBA persons, stable across seasons and clubs; 3-9 digits, older players have short ids (393433) and newer ones 100xxxxxx). Joins the player box routes, the season player lists and getPlayersByScheduleId. Not a team id.
player_piccharacterAbsolute URL of the player's photo; null when there is none.
positioncharacterPosition code as registered: SG, SF, PG, PF, C and their '/' pairs, or the coarse G (guard) / F (forward) on older rows (see positionDescription). Label glosses: C = (Chinese text); C/PF = (Chinese text); F = (Chinese text); G = (Chinese text); PF = (Chinese text); PF/C = (Chinese text); PF/SF = (Chinese text); PG = (Chinese text); PG/SG = (Chinese text); SF = (Chinese text); SF/PF = (Chinese text); SF/SG = (Chinese text); SG = (Chinese text); SG/PG = (Chinese text); SG/SF = (Chinese text); (Chinese text); (Chinese text); (Chinese text); (Chinese text); (Chinese text); (Chinese text); (Chinese text); (Chinese text); (Chinese text); (Chinese text); (Chinese text); (Chinese text); (Chinese text).
position_descriptioncharacterPosition label (Chinese). Eras differ: coarse (Chinese text) (guard) / (Chinese text) (forward) / (Chinese text) (center) in older seasons, five-way (Chinese text) (point guard) / (Chinese text) (shooting guard) / (Chinese text) (small forward) / (Chinese text) (power forward) / (Chinese text) (center) in newer ones; dual positions are joined with '/' (e.g. (Chinese text)). Label glosses: C = (Chinese text); C/PF = (Chinese text); F = (Chinese text); G = (Chinese text); PF = (Chinese text); PF/C = (Chinese text); PF/SF = (Chinese text); PG = (Chinese text); PG/SG = (Chinese text); SF = (Chinese text); SF/PF = (Chinese text); SF/SG = (Chinese text); SG = (Chinese text); SG/PG = (Chinese text); SG/SF = (Chinese text); (Chinese text); (Chinese text); (Chinese text); (Chinese text); (Chinese text); (Chinese text); (Chinese text); (Chinese text); (Chinese text); (Chinese text); (Chinese text); (Chinese text); (Chinese text).
position_stringcharacterUnobserved: null in every sample.
seasonintegerSeason START year (2025 = the 2025-26 season). The sdv season key is the END year = season + 1; map at the boundary.
season_idintegerSeason START year (2025 = the 2025-26 season). The sdv season key is the END year = season + 1; map at the boundary. Same value as season.
season_namecharacterUnobserved: null in every sample.
season_yearcharacterUnobserved: null in every sample.
team_cba_idintegerteamId again as an integer (29128); meaning unverified beyond equalling team_id in the sample.
team_cn_aliascharacterTeam short name (Chinese) in that season.
team_cn_namecharacterTeam full legal name (Chinese), e.g. 'Zhejiang Guangsha Lions Club Zheshang Securities basketball team'.
team_en_aliascharacterTeam code or English city name as registered: a three-letter code on recent rows ('ZGL', 'SBW'), an English city name on older ones ('Guangdong', 'Sichuan'), ” when none.
team_en_namecharacterTeam English name as the league registers it (the sample reads 'GUANG SHA').
team_idintegerteamId (key space: CBA clubs; 5 digits 29115-29140 for the long-standing clubs, 9 digits for newer ones (100074683 = Ningbo); stable across seasons and club renames, but the display name changes with the sponsor: 29128 = 'Zhejiang Guangsha' under many sponsor names, (Chinese text) in 2025-26). Joins getTeam / teamList and the team and player routes. Not a player or schedule id.
weightintegerWeight in kg (integer).

Details

  • Unofficial and unsupported: these wrappers read the routes that cbaleague.com's own data site (a Vue single-page app) calls. SportsDataverse has not ruled on the site's terms, so payloads are not redistributed as release assets. Requests are spaced at least 1 s apart per host; keep use small.

  • Access: every response body is AES-128-ECB encrypted with a public key shipped in the site's front-end bundle; the runtime decrypts it with digest::AES() (digest is a suggested package: install it to use these wrappers) and refuses anything that does not decrypt. The host blocks datacenter IPs at TCP: set the environment variable CBA_PROXY (or options(hoopR.proxy = ...)) to a residential proxy URL; it is never printed or put in a condition. Without a proxy the request goes direct and, from a datacenter, fails within seconds (a 5 s connect timeout, no retry of a refused or timed-out connect). Where direct access works (a residential IP), set CBA_DIRECT=1 for the full 60 s timeout and retries.

  • Seasons: the API's season is the START year; every season argument here is the END year (2026 = 2025-26) and is sent as season - 1. Columns named season keep the wire value (the START year, so the sdv END year is season + 1). The season list reaches 1995-96; box data before 2009-10 is unverified.

  • Coverage: game wrappers serve FINISHED games only. Each first reads the game report header (cached per session), and an unfinished game raises hoopR_asset_fetch. Box, period, roster and best-player bodies are checked against that header (points sum to the score, team ids match, advanced rows are box players). Play-by-play is served one period per request: every period is fetched, and a partial set, an unordered clock or a final score the plays do not reach is refused. Play-by-play is verified on 2017-18 and 2025-26 only and is absent for 2009-10 (hoopR_no_data). There are NO shot x/y coordinates in this API (shot location exists only as team and player zone splits), and play-by-play has no player or team ids (Chinese sentence text plus surnames). Box data has 12-minute quarters in 2009-10 and 2017-18 and 10-minute quarters in 2025-26. The women's CBA is not covered (no official source).

  • Not game data: cba_game_team_shots() and cba_game_team_four() answer the two teams' SEASON tables (the shot zones are the teams' current profile; the four factors are the previous season), whichever game is asked for. The reference lists (cba_team_options(), cba_team_counts()) and cba_report_status() are not echoed by the API, so their scope is unchecked.

  • Duplicate rows: in some games (2025-26 game 100105799) the advanced-box and extras routes repeat player rows (26 rows for 12 players), and the repeats are not always copies. cba_player_advanced() and cba_player_extras() keep the FIRST row per player_id.

  • Text fields are Chinese (names, play-by-play sentences, position and nationality labels). The column descriptions here are ASCII; sdv-py's tools/codegen/notes/cba_glossary.yaml holds the full English glossaries.

  • Personal data: the operator ids (createdBy / lastModifiedBy, one holds a mobile number) and any bare mobile-number string are removed from every body. Players' public bio fields (birth date, height, weight) are kept.

  • Ids: schedule_id (games, one global 9-digit sequence 100xxxxxx), team_id (clubs, stable across sponsor renames), player_id (persons) and match_type_id are integers. The roster registration id of cba_rosters() is a 19-digit integer that an R integer or double cannot hold exactly, so it is kept as its exact digits (character).

  • Errors are classed conditions: hoopR_no_data (HTTP 404, a game without play-by-play), hoopR_bad_request (a non-integer id or season, HTTP 400 / 422) and hoopR_asset_fetch (any other non-200, including HTTP 500, which this API answers for a body it dislikes and which is not retried; a dead connection; an empty or undecryptable body; an unfinished game; a body for another game, team, season or day), all inheriting hoopR_error. HTTP 429 / 502 / 503 / 504 are retried, up to three attempts. Wrappers raise; they never warn and return empty.
